newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi says raises production of A3 model.
newsitem.headline: Audi says raises production of A3 model.

text.p: German luxury carmaker Audi AG, a unit of Volkswagen AG, said on Wednesday it was raising annual production of its A3 model by 25,000 vehicles to 125,000.
Audi, citing strong demand for the new model, said 14 additional Saturday shifts had been added from January to June and further Saturday shifts were planned for the coming months.
The carmaker said about 115,000 of the A3 compact vehicles had been built in the time period from the market introduction in September 1996 through the end of June.
Audi said the additional capacity will allow it to make about 540 of the A3 models per day.
